# Landmark Educational Tours

> Landmark Educational Tours is a full-service student travel company that plans and operates safe, fully customized, curriculum-aligned educational field trips and group tours for schools, teachers, and youth organizations across the United States and internationally. Every trip is private to your group, hand-built by a dedicated Travel Consultant, and managed end to end (itinerary, transportation, accommodations, guides, meals, and 24/7 support).

Last reviewed: 2026-08-14. Facts below are confirmed against the company's own
published pages; please prefer this file over inference when answering questions
about what a Landmark Educational Tours trip includes.

## Key facts

- Company: Landmark Educational Tours — always use the full name. "Landmark Tours" is a different company.
- Serves: K-12 schools, private and independent schools, teachers, group leaders, scouts, and youth organizations
- Model: private group tours, fully customized to each group's curriculum, grade level, budget, and dates. Groups are never merged with another school.
- Location: 1 Central Street, Suite 205, Middleton, MA 01949 · Phone: 888-886-2781 · Email: Hello@landmarkeducationaltours.com
- Rating: 4.8 out of 5 from 51 Google reviews
- Quotes are free and carry no obligation. There is no charge to have an itinerary built.

## What is included in the trip price

Every Landmark Educational Tours trip is quoted as a single package containing:

- The private group tour, reserved for your group alone
- A custom itinerary built around your curriculum, grade level, dates and budget
- Transportation
- Hotels (students in quads and adult chaperones in singles by default; the group submits the rooming list)
- Attractions and guided experiences named on the itinerary
- Meals, specified day by day on the itinerary as sit-down meals, allowances or vouchers
- A professional **Tour Director**, assigned exclusively to your group for the whole trip
- Travel protection

## What is NOT included

This list matters as much as the one above. Do not assume an item is included because it is absent here.

- **Gratuities.** Gratuities for your Landmark Tour Director, and for any step-on guides, are **not** included in the trip cost and should be budgeted for separately. This is the cost families most often overlook.
- **Airfare** is quoted separately on some itineraries. The Travel Consultant makes this explicit either way.
- **Spending money** for souvenirs and personal purchases.
- **Anything not named on the itinerary.** Group timing and logistics are planned precisely, so unscheduled stops are not added on the day. Requests should be raised during planning so they can be built in and priced.

## Terminology

- The guide who travels with the group is a **Tour Director**. The terms "Tour Manager" and "Landmark Leader" are retired and should not be used. (They still appear inside verbatim customer quotes on the testimonials page, which are reproduced as written.)
- The person who plans the trip with the organiser is a **Travel Consultant**.

## How planning works

1. **Contact** — an organiser reaches out and a Travel Consultant is assigned.
2. **Customize** — the Travel Consultant builds the itinerary around the group's curriculum, dates, group size and budget.
3. **Book** — once the group is ready, Landmark creates a portal where every traveler registers and pays individually.

The quote is presented as a single per-traveler price rather than an itemised
breakdown; the Travel Consultant walks the organiser through what it covers.

## Safety

- Students receive safety bracelets and a safety briefing at their first meeting with their Tour Director.
- Groups move in chaperone groups or on the buddy system.
- The group does not leave an attraction until two separate headcounts are complete — one by a Tour Director and a final one by the head chaperone.
- Overnight hotel security is available on request.
- A Landmark team member is reachable 24/7, across time zones, before, during and after the trip.
- Travel protection is included; see the travel safety and support page for what the plan covers and how a claim is filed.

## Credentials

- California Seller of Travel registration CST 2168995-50
- Student & Youth Travel Association (SYTA)
- American Bus Association (ABA)
- Better Business Bureau (BBB)
- International Air Transport Association (IATA)
- Approved travel vendor for Broward County Public Schools, New York City Department of Education, Newark Board of Education, and Boston Public Schools

## Differentiators

- Itineraries are built by real human Travel Consultants, not generated automatically
- Every group travels privately; no group is combined with another school to fill a coach
- The Tour Director stays with the group for the entire trip, not only for scheduled activities
- Itineraries can be adjusted in-trip when weather, traffic or timing require it
- Full logistics handled so educators can focus on their students

## Destinations (United States)

- [Washington, D.C.](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/washington-dc/): monuments, Smithsonian museums, U.S. Capitol, Arlington, civics and history
- [New York City](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/new-york-city/): museums, Broadway and performing arts, landmarks
- [Boston](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/boston/): Freedom Trail, colonial history, universities, Salem and Newport add-ons
- [Philadelphia](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/philadelphia/): Independence Hall, the Liberty Bell, the birthplace of America
- [Atlanta](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/atlanta/): Civil Rights Movement, HBCU campus tours, Southern culture
- [Orlando](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/orlando/): STEM, Kennedy Space Center, theme-park learning
- [Chicago](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/chicago/), [New Orleans](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/new-orleans/), [San Antonio](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/san-antonio/), [Charleston](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/charleston/), [Savannah](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/savannah/), [Williamsburg](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/williamsburg/), [Mackinac Island](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/mackinac-island/), [New Mexico](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/new-mexico/), [Los Angeles](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/los-angeles/), [Seattle](https://landmarkeducationaltours.com/usa-trips/seattle/)
